title: Kilmainham Gaol
scope: The surviving gaol complex at Inchicore Road, including the original west range, Victorian east range, main entrance and governor’s front court, and high limestone enclosure around the Stonebreakers’ Yard.
limitations: The outer wall and connected building silhouettes are tied to current map data. Roof pitches, wall height transitions, internal bay alignment, and smaller openings are estimated from the architectural inventory and the story photograph.
The former courthouse is a separate neighbor and interiors are outside the exterior model.
